display.purpose: The page's three or four genuine statements only: the hero headline, the footer's closing line, and the conversion band's phone number.

headline.purpose: Section headings. Balanced wrapping via text-wrap: balance.

title.purpose: Card and panel titles inside a section.

body.purpose: All running copy. Measure held to 65-75ch.

field.purpose: Text the visitor types into. 16px is a floor, not a preference: below it iOS zooms the viewport on focus and the visitor loses the form.

ui.purpose: Form labels, small meta lines, secondary interface text that is read rather than scanned.

caption.purpose: Helper text and validation messages. The smallest text that must still read comfortably.

label.purpose: Step numbers, stat labels, contact categories. The tracked uppercase register, not a general small size.

brand.purpose: The word Solstice and nothing else, at any size from navbar to footer monument.

shadows.name: contact-small
shadows.purpose: Chips and small controls resting lightly on a warm ground.

shadows.name: contact-card
shadows.purpose: Case cards and About panels at rest.

shadows.name: contact-deep
shadows.purpose: The largest raised surfaces, where the drop must read across a full section.

shadows.name: contact-night
shadows.purpose: The same contact shadow on a night ground, where darkness carries the tint.

shadows.name: inset-hairline
shadows.purpose: A lit edge on dark panels, used instead of a border so the corner radius stays clean.

motion.name: ease-arrival
motion.purpose: The system default for anything arriving or settling. Exponential out: decisive, never overshooting.

motion.name: ease-mode
motion.purpose: The morning/night token crossfade, 0.6s. Flat at both ends so the change has no corner.

motion.name: ease-step
motion.purpose: GSAP step transitions in the pinned card stage, 0.6s. Arrives decisively without crossing the target.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Colour-only transitions when the hour changes.

motion.name: marquee-a
motion.purpose: Testimonial column A. Must stay linear: any easing on a loop that wraps at -50% pulses once per cycle.

motion.name: marquee-b
motion.purpose: Testimonial column B. Deliberately unequal to A, or the pair reads as one hinged object.

components.name: Primary Button (daylight)
components.description: The navbar CTA under morning light. Inverts to a lit fill at night.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 11px; background: #0d0d0d; color: #f7f5ee; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.18s ease, filter 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.04); filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d0d0d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Call Action
components.description: The conversion band's primary action on a night ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-call { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f7eeda; color: #14100a; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-call:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #fffaf0; } .ds-btn-call:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d5b16a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Action
components.description: Subordinate actions on a night ground. Hairline only; never a second fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(247,238,218,0.16); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: rgba(247,238,218,0.62); font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(247,238,218,0.36); color: #f7eeda; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d5b16a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A form field on lit paper. Required marks and errors carry the Warn state colour; focus takes a Low Sun ring.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: #121212; } .ds-field-req { margin-left: 3px; color: #8f3a1e; } .ds-field { width: 100%; padding: 13px 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(18,18,18,0.14); border-radius: 12px; background: #faf7f0; color: #121212; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.4; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: rgba(18,18,18,0.58); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgba(18,18,18,0.24); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; background: #fffdf8; border-color: #b08a53; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b08a53; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Region Chip
components.description: Map region filter. Selection is carried by hairline strength and a contact shadow, never by colour alone.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip" type="button">Amudarya Delta</button><button class="ds-chip ds-chip--on" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Aral North</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(176,138,83,0.24); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #121212; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(176,138,83,0.45); } .ds-chip--on { border-color: rgba(176,138,83,0.45); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -12px rgba(120,88,40,0.45); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b08a53; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Case Card
components.description: A raised paper surface on warm ground. Depth is contact, not lift.
components.html:
The Seytniyazov Family

10.2 kW in Nukus District. Bill has not moved off zero since the install.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 360px; padding: 30px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border-radius: 16px; background: #fffdf8; box-shadow: 0 20px 38px -26px rgba(120,88,40,0.55); transition: box-shadow 0.35s ease, transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 26px 56px -30px rgba(96,74,38,0.55); } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 10px; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: #121212; } .ds-card__body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.62; color: rgba(18,18,18,0.72); }

components.name: Testimonial Card
components.description: One quote. No portrait, no rating, no quotation glyph: at this size the sentence is the design.
components.css: .ds-quote { max-width: 380px; margin: 0; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(92,92,94,0.16); border-radius: 16px; background: #fffdf8; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -12px rgba(120,88,40,0.45); } .ds-quote__text { margin: 0 0 18px; font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #3f3f41; } .ds-quote__who { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-quote__name { font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #5c5c5e; } .ds-quote__meta { font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #7a7a7c; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Inline links plus one CTA. Below 1025px the links collapse into a burger; the CTA never collapses.
components.html: How It WorksOur CasesAbout Us
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav__link { font-family: 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(17,17,17,0.64); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav__link:hover, .ds-nav__link--on { color: #111111; } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b08a53; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Map Pin
components.description: A real button so it carries a focus ring. Positioned from true lat/lon through the map's georeference, never by eye.
components.html: <button class="ds-pin" type="button" aria-label="Nukus District"></button><button class="ds-pin ds-pin--on" type="button" aria-label="Kungrad District" aria-pressed="true"></button>
components.css: .ds-pin { width: 46px; height: 46px; margin-right: 10px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; position: relative; } .ds-pin::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(176,138,83,0.45); background: #fffdf8; transition: inset 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-pin--on::after { inset: 12px; background: #b08a53; border-color: #b08a53; } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b08a53; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The system is a day passing. That is not a metaphor applied afterward — it is the literal structure of the code. Nearly every colour token in this project exists twice, once for morning and once for night, and the page opens on a house you can flip between the two. The About section then runs the full arc as a scrubbed timeline through four light stops, and the argument it makes by doing so is the product's actual argument: the ground goes dark and the windows stay lit.

Everything else follows from that. Surfaces here are not colours, they are light states, and the correct question when adding one is never "which cream" but "what hour is this". A section that resets to a neutral background because it is a new section has broken the system more than one that picks the wrong hex. Between the dusk of About and the morning of the testimonial wall sits a near-black band holding a phone number in lit ink; it works because it is 9pm, not because dark sections look premium.

The tone is plain and unornamented, and it is enforced by subtraction. Testimonials carry no ratings, no portraits, no quotation glyphs. The map is georeferenced rather than decorative. There is one accent colour and it is rationed. The restraint is not minimalism as a style — it is the belief that a specific fact outperforms a superlative, which is stated outright in the project's own source comments and should survive every future addition.
keyCharacteristics: Every surface is an hour of the day, not a palette slot.
One accent, used rarely and always load-bearing.
Warm throughout: no neutral grey, no neutral black, no neutral shadow.
Two weights of one typeface carry the whole page; the brand face appears on the brand only.
Motion argues or it is cut — the test is whether it survives the narrow breakpoint.

rules.name: The Hour Rule
rules.body: A new surface picks its background by naming the hour it happens at, then taking the matching token. Sections do not get their own colours; they get positions in the day. If you cannot say what time it is, the section is not designed yet.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: Low Sun appears on well under a tenth of any screen and never as a fill for a large area. It marks the single active thing, the single route, the single hairline that matters. A second accent hue does not exist in this system; if something needs to stand out and gold is taken, the answer is weight, size, or a lit surface — not a new colour.

rules.name: The No Neutral Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system is neutral grey or pure black. Secondary text is the foreground ink at reduced alpha so it keeps the surface's temperature; a grey at any opacity reads as dirt on these creams. Shadows follow the same rule.

rules.name: The Brand Face Rule
rules.body: Unbounded sets the word "Solstice" and never another word. A heading, a button, a stat or a pull-quote in the brand face is a system violation regardless of how well it reads.

rules.name: The Answer Rule
rules.body: The phone number in the conversion band is set at the hero headline's scale on purpose: the hero asks and it answers. When a page element is the direct reply to another, match its scale rather than stepping down a level out of habit.

rules.name: The Contact Rule
rules.body: Every shadow's blur exceeds its offset and its spread is negative. A shadow with zero or positive spread, or with a neutral colour, does not belong to this system — it will read as a generic card drop against these warm grounds.

dos: Do pick a new surface's background by naming the hour it happens at, then taking that token (The Hour Rule).
Do tint every secondary text colour from the foreground ink at reduced alpha, so it keeps the surface's temperature.
Do give every shadow a negative spread and a warm tint (The Contact Rule).
Do ration Low Sun to the single active element, route, or hairline that matters (The One Sun Rule).
Do tune display type through --display-scale, --display-weight-delta and --display-tracking-delta rather than editing rules individually.
Do theme the surfaces the browser would otherwise own — selection, focus rings, tabular figures on numeric data.
Do test a new motion idea by asking whether it survives the narrow breakpoint. If cutting it loses nothing, it was decoration.
donts: Don't set anything other than the word "Solstice" in Unbounded (The Brand Face Rule).
Don't introduce a second accent hue. Use weight, scale, or a lit surface instead.
Don't use neutral grey, pure black, or a neutral shadow anywhere (The No Neutral Rule).
Don't add a fourth scroll-pinned sequence. Three is the ration; a fourth turns the page into a slideshow.
Don't give a section a background colour because it is a new section. That is the most common way to break the day.
Don't add ratings, portraits, logos, or quotation glyphs to testimonials. Their plainness is the argument.
Don't place a map pin, a route, or a coordinate by eye. The geography is real and stays real.
Don't animate a layout property (width, height, margin, flex-basis) where a transform expresses the same change.
